rule.comment: This rule marks events in the given containers for processing by adding the unmached-src-dn and attempt-to-match operation properties. You can add subtrees in the Identity Vault for inclusion by adding if-src-dn conditionals here. If you are using mirrored placement, the unmatched-src-dn is used later in the placement rule. The attempt-to-match property determines whether the matching policies following this initializing policy should try to match the object or whether its out of scope.
